correctness.rationale: For the assigned quartic Q_R, directly recomputed the four homogeneous partials at R=(1:2:3:4), verified all five prescribed points, and independently formed the rational lex Gröbner basis of the projective-gradient ideal at w=1. Its last eliminant is (2z+3)(4z-3)^4(8z+3)/4096, and solving at its three roots recovers exactly the five affine points. On w=0 the three projective charts have no common gradient zeros. At R, Taylor terms of degree <3 vanish and the cubic T=-(3/2)(84s²u-378s²v-252su²+567sv²+74u²v-37uv²) has no critical point on any chart of P²; the triple-point germ is ordinary, with smooth cubic exceptional divisor of self-intersection -3. At R_1,...,R_4 the affine Hessian determinants are 10762227/2, -530181288, 4921675101/2, and -121002336, all nonzero, proving A1. Smoothness of the strict transform on blowing up the moving triple-point section, local Hessian stability at node sections, and properness away from those sections furnish a nonempty Zariski-open parameter neighborhood with no residual singularities. This is an exact witness plus algebraic openness argument, not finite sampling as proof of all parameters.
